name: Kender
heading: Kender Racial Traits and Afflicted Kender Racial Traits
distinction: This one player profile includes both true and afflicted kender. Half-kender and fifth-edition Kender have separate rules. The NPC is a true kender.

name: Tarmak
heading: Ithin’carthian Racial Traits, Tarmaks
distinction: Uses the Tarmak traits of this chapter. Damjatts and Keena are separate Ithin’carthian options. The NPC does not take Hulking Brute.

name: Kyrie
heading: Kyrie Racial Traits and Kyrie Racial Class
distinction: Kyrie of Krynn, with human faces and feathered arm-wings. The worked NPC uses the first racial-class tier and the Animal domain. It retains the common Kyrie size, land speed and darkvision from the full species entry. Treat the racial domain power as caster level 1 for its duration.

name: Phaethon
heading: Phaethon Racial Traits
distinction: Uses base player traits. The NPC uses the core monk without Phaethon alternative class features or the Elder Phaethon prestige class.
